source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: No hole map found; the open nine's order was worked out from the photo (green and tee positions, card lengths). Holes 1, 2, 3, 8 and 9 especially are a best guess. Only nine holes are open (reviews: back nine closed for renovation, each green has two pins to play 18). Holes 10-18 are drawn on the same nine as 1-9; the old back nine land NE of the lagoon is bare in the photo.
unsure.1: Tee placed in the bare, dug-up strip by the cart bridge from the clubhouse; this strip looked under renovation in the photo.
unsure.9: Fairway runs through the same bare, dug-up strip; green taken as the one by the clubhouse.
